title: S121 Wrong Choices Behavior Simulation
methodology: Direct structural analysis of output patterns by question type and learner context using representative Pack A items. Compares old behavior (flat ExplanationWrong list) to new behavior (4-section structured misconception coaching).

scenarios.example: P1A-FS-001 (External Financial Reporting, Section A, CC=B)
scenarios.context: Learner selected C, active session, has answered
scenarios.oldBehavior: Listed each wrong option with ExplanationWrong text: 'Option A — choice text + explanation', 'Option C — choice text + explanation', 'Option D — choice text + explanation'
scenarios.newBehavior: Opens with 'Let's start with the answer you chose' — addresses Choice C (selected) first with *(your answer)* tag. Then A, then D. Each gets 4 coaching sections: Why tempting, Why not correct, Misconception to watch, How to avoid next time.
scenarios.coachingInsightAdded: Yes — selected-answer prioritization, misconception identification, avoidance strategy per choice
scenarios.officialContentPreserved: Yes — ExplanationWrongA/C/D embedded in Why it is not correct sections
scenarios.answerGatingHeld: Yes — attempted state detected, full coaching allowed

scenarios.context: Learner selected A, active session, has answered
scenarios.oldBehavior: Listed wrong options A, B, D with ExplanationWrong or generic fallback
scenarios.newBehavior: Choice A prioritized with *(your answer)*. Why-it-is-tempting detects calculation distractor pattern. Misconception points to formula-setup error. Avoid-next-time suggests formula-first approach.
scenarios.coachingInsightAdded: Yes — calc-specific trap detection, formula-setup misconception, step-by-step avoidance

scenarios.example: Mock QID with thin/missing ExplanationWrong fields for options A, C, D
scenarios.oldBehavior: Output generic fallback: 'This choice is incorrect. It does not match the correct accounting treatment...' for each option
scenarios.newBehavior: Uses safe fallback for Why it is not correct — 'This choice does not match the correct accounting treatment... When you trace the governing rule back...' Tempting uses stem/choice overlap analysis. Misconception uses section-aligned fallback.
scenarios.coachingInsightAdded: Yes — structural coaching preserved even with thin ExplanationWrong, no fabrication
scenarios.officialContentPreserved: N/A — no official content to preserve, but no fabrication introduced
scenarios.answerGatingHeld: Yes — review mode permits full coaching

scenarios.example: Any MCQ, learner in active session, no answer submitted
scenarios.context: Learner clicks 'Wrong choices' button before answering
scenarios.oldBehavior: Listed all wrong options with ExplanationWrong — NO GATE, revealed which options were wrong before attempt
scenarios.newBehavior: Strategy-only response: 'I can help you evaluate the options without giving away the answer. After you submit, I'll break down each wrong choice and the trap behind it.' Provides general distractor evaluation tips (calc or conceptual). No coaching sections, no option mentions.
scenarios.coachingInsightAdded: N/A — gated, no wrong choices revealed
scenarios.answerGatingHeld: YES — active unanswered question does not disclose which options are wrong

scenarios.example: Any Pack A item viewed through review queue after session completion
scenarios.context: Session completed, learner reviewing wrong answers
scenarios.oldBehavior: Listed wrong options with ExplanationWrong text
scenarios.newBehavior: Full coaching with review framing: 'Let's use this review as a learning opportunity.' All 4 coaching sections per option + 'Pulling it together' summary section at end connecting wrong-choice analysis to correct-concept boundaries.
scenarios.coachingInsightAdded: Yes — review-mode bonus (Pulling it together), full coaching structure, learning-opportunity framing
scenarios.answerGatingHeld: Yes — review mode intentionally permits full reveal

antiLeakage.unansweredGate: CONFIRMED — active unanswered questions receive strategy-only output without revealing which options are right or wrong
antiLeakage.correctChoiceExclusion: CONFIRMED — correct choice never appears in wrong-choice coaching output
antiLeakage.selectedAnswerReveal: CONFIRMED — selected answer shown only when learner has already answered (visible in mini-panel already)

antiFabrication.thinExplanationPath: CONFIRMED — safe fallback used, no invented standards/ASC/FASB/COSO citations
antiFabrication.whyTemptingInference: CONFIRMED — uses stem/choice overlap analysis, calculation pattern detection, and section-aligned generic patterns without fabrication
antiFabrication.misconceptionInference: CONFIRMED — uses ExplanationWrong signals when available, section-aligned fallback when thin

safetyGatesPreserved._guardedSpeak: CONFIRMED — wrong-choices output routes through _guardedSpeak in pilot mode
safetyGatesPreserved.predictionLanguage: CONFIRMED — no exam-ready/pass/guaranteed-to-pass language in any coaching output

old.structure: Flat list: Option letter + choice text + ExplanationWrong
old.learnerAwareness: None — always same output regardless of learner state
old.gating: None — no check for unanswered question

new.structure: 4-section coaching per option: Why tempting, Why not correct, Misconception to watch, How to avoid next time
new.learnerAwareness: 3 contexts: unanswered (strategy only), post-answer (selected first + coaching), review (full coaching + summary)
new.gating: Active unanswered → strategy-only, no option reveal
new.coachingDepth: Deep — misconception analysis, trap awareness, avoidance patterns, concept boundaries
new.selectedAnswerPriority: Yes — selected wrong answer moved to first position with *(your answer)* tag
